title: Retro with a long silence and a recorded gap
description: Two people; twenty seconds of silence while the user looks something up, then a six-second recorded gap (device switch) on both tracks.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Hi Sam, can you hear me all right? My headset has been playing up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: I can hear you fine. Let's do the retro for the payments release.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: What went well is that the rollout was smooth. We shipped behind a flag and turned it on region by region.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Agreed. What didn't go so well?

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: The alerts were too noisy. We got paged eleven times for the same warning.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Let me pull up the incident timeline. Give me a moment.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Okay, found it. The warning fired every time the cache was cold.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Then we should raise the threshold, or only alert after five minutes.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Sorry, I switched to my speakers. Did you catch the last part?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Yes. Let's alert only after five minutes. I'll make the change.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Great. And remember, the retry budget is three attempts, then dead-letter, for the payment webhooks too.

facts.text: Great. And remember, the retry budget is three attempts, then dead-letter, for the payment webhooks too.
